sections.description: A small Hi-C map with its matching FASTA reference.

sections.title: DNA Zoo chromosome-length assemblies
sections.description: Hi-C maps with the genome assemblies they were used to scaffold, shared by the DNA Zoo Consortium. Large downloads: check your disk space first.

examples.title: Tardigrade quick start
examples.description: A 12.6 MB Hi-C map and 32.7 MB FASTA. Open example downloads, converts and opens the five mapped chromosomes. The FASTA also includes unplaced scaffolds absent from the map.

examples.title: Cheetah (Acinonyx jubatus)
examples.description: A chromosome-length cheetah assembly (aciJub1_HiC, 2n=38) with its Hi-C map. Shows scaffolding of a draft genome into chromosomes: contigs, scaffolds and the assembly file used to build them.

examples.title: Yellow fever mosquito (Aedes aegypti)
examples.description: The AaegL5.0 yellow fever mosquito assembly (2n=6) and its Hi-C map, the genome that demonstrated chromosome-length scaffolding with Hi-C. Three large chromosomes make the structure easy to read.
